title: ReflectScene:MLLM-Guided Closed-Loop Diffusion for 3D Indoor Scene Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.23845v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text-conditioned 3D indoor scene generation requires layouts satisfying geometric, functional, and semantic constraints. However, existing diffusion methods rely primarily on static textual conditions, limiting their ability to assess evolving scenes and translate semantic discrepancies into executable object-level corrections. MLLM-based post-hoc refinement provides semantic feedback but remains decoupled from denoising, potentially disrupting scene coherence.We propose ReflectScene, an MLLM-guided closed-loop diffusion framework. First, we introduce Hierarchical Prior-Grounded Scene Understanding that aligns structured layouts with multi-view visual evidence, to interpret object-specific context and scene global semantics via a frozen multi-modal large language model (MLLM). Second, we propose MLLM-Guided Semantic Reward Evaluation to distill MLLM's diagnoses and assessments on possible candidate corrections into a lightweight Reward

translated_title: ReflectScene：MLLM引导的闭环扩散模型用于3D室内场景生成
translated_abstract: 基于文本条件的3D室内场景生成需要生成满足几何、功能和语义约束的布局。然而，现有的扩散方法主要依赖静态的文本条件，限制了其评估演化中场景状态的能力，也难以将语义偏差转化为可执行的对象级修正。基于MLLM（多模态大语言模型）的事后细化方法虽能提供语义反馈，但与去噪过程相解耦，可能破坏场景的一致性。我们提出了ReflectScene，一个MLLM引导的闭环扩散框架。首先，我们引入了分层先验锚定的场景理解机制，将结构化布局与多视角视觉证据对齐，借助冻结的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）来解释对象特定的上下文和场景全局语义。其次，我们提出了MLLM引导的语义奖励评估，将MLLM对候选修正方案的诊断和评估提炼为轻量级奖励信号……
tldr: 提出ReflectScene框架，将MLLM的语义诊断以轻量级奖励信号实时融入扩散去噪过程，形成闭环反馈，生成更符合几何、功能与语义约束的3D室内场景。
en_tdlr: ReflectScene introduces an MLLM-guided closed-loop diffusion framework that distills MLLM's semantic diagnoses into lightweight reward signals integrated into the denoising process, enabling text-conditioned 3D indoor scene generation that satisfies geometric, functional, and semantic constraints.
